question_text: A 68-year old woman presents with recurring headaches and pain while combing her hair. Her past medical history is significant for hypertension, glaucoma and chronic deep vein thrombosis in her right leg. Current medication includes rivaroxaban, latanoprost, and benazepril. Her vitals include: blood pressure 130/82 mm Hg, pulse 74/min, respiratory rate 14/min, temperature 36.6℃ (97.9℉). Physical examination reveals neck stiffness and difficulty standing up due to pain in the lower limbs. Strength is 5 out of 5 in the upper and lower extremities bilaterally. Which of the following is the next best step in the management of this patient?
